呼！真走运！不知怎么，我还是成功了。把它带给你正在培养的可爱魔物吧。蝗虫眼镜！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
For the monster owner that likes monster glasses, we provide a way to make Rocker Glasses!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌]
如果你喜欢给魔物戴眼镜，我们可以教你制作蝗虫眼镜！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Just bring me...
^3355FF2 Zargon^000000
^3355FF1 Ribbon^000000 and
^3355FF400 zeny^000000. 
I will make it for you, with all my pride as a monster tamer!
scripts.translation:
[尤乌]
带来^3355FF2个刹勒空结晶^000000、^3355FF1条丝带^000000和^3355FF400 Zeny^000000，我就会以驯兽师的骄傲为你制作！

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌]
啊...！
您一定还没决定好要培养哪种魔物。

scripts.text:
[YuU]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[尤乌]
这绝对不是一个可以草率决定的事情！您的宠物魔物将伴随您一生。请慢慢考虑，决定好后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Are you pre-occupied with
gathering items for monsters
and want a break? 
We will gather items
for your Cute Pets.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
你正忙着为魔物收集道具，想歇一歇吗？我们可以替你收集宠物所需的道具。

scripts.text: ^3355FF' Monster Taming '^000000?
Order ^3355FF' Book of Devil '^000000
Order ^3355FF' No Recipient '^000000
Order ^3355FF' Orc Trophy '^000000
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
The monster taming items are necessary to communicate with the monster of your choice! We Monster Tamer guild members have a very reasonable offer...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
驯兽道具是与你选定的魔物沟通所必需的！我们驯兽师公会为你准备了优惠价格...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
We provide a system that allows you to get your hands on these cool items with less of the hassle!
Book of Devil!
No Recipient!
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
我们有办法让你轻松获得这些好用的道具！恶魔之书、无人认领的信、兽人奖杯！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 Book of Devil, you can exchange:
^3355FF1 Old Magic Book^000000
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
1本恶魔之书可用^3355FF1本古魔法书^000000和^3355FF2个亡者之牙^000000兑换。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For 1 No Recipient, you can exchange ^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
1幅破旧画像可兑换^3355FF1封无人认领的信^000000。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Lastly, you can exchange
^3355FF1 Chivalry Emblem^000000 and
^3355FF1 Scorpion Tail^000000
for 1 Orc Trophy.
Try these fantastic items!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
最后，你可以用^3355FF1枚骑士团之证^000000和^3355FF1条蝎子尾巴^000000兑换1个兽人奖杯。试试这些好东西吧！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond what humans can read! Its name? ^3355FFBook of Devil^000000! A very mysterious item that can supposedly summon demons...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
这件道具远超人类的理解！它的名字是？^3355FF恶魔之书^000000！据说这是一件能召唤恶魔的神秘道具...

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make 1 Book of Devil! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你带齐了制作1本恶魔之书所需的材料！很好，很好！我会以驯兽师的骄傲，马上为你制作一本。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Let's see...
Hmm, this is going to be hard.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
让我看看...嗯，这有点难办。

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Knock knock scrape scrape*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*咚咚 咚咚 刮擦 刮擦*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take it for
the cute monster you
are raising.
Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把它带给你正在饲养的可爱魔物吧。恶魔之书！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the owner that wishes to raise a monster that can be summoned using the Book of Devil, we provide a way to create 1 Book of Devil!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
如果你想饲养能用恶魔之书召唤的魔物，我们可以教你制作1本恶魔之书！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Magicbook^000000 and
^3355FF2 Horrendous Mouth^000000!
If you bring me these items, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
带来^3355FF1本古魔法书^000000和^3355FF2个亡者之牙^000000，我就会以驯兽师的骄傲为你制作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item which expresses feelings beyond what a human can feel. Its name? ^3355FFNo Recipient^000000! Who sent this letter, and who was supposed to receive it?
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
这件道具承载着人类难以体会的情感。它的名字是？^3355FF无人认领的信^000000！这封信是谁寄出的，又是寄给谁的？

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make No Recipient! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make one for you right away.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你带齐了制作无人认领的信所需的材料！很好，很好！我会以驯兽师的骄傲，马上为你制作一封。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to fold this Old Portrait just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得把这幅旧肖像折叠得恰到好处...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Scrape scrape brush brush*^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF*刮擦 刮擦 刷刷 刷刷*^000000

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this item
for the cute monster
you are raising.
No Recipient!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把这件道具带给你正在饲养的可爱魔物吧。无人认领的信！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner that is fond of No Recipient, we provide a way to create to special item!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
如果你喜欢无人认领的信，我们可以教你制作这件特别道具！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Just bring me...
^3355FF1 Old Portrait^000000!
If you bring this to me, with all my pride as a monster tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
带来^3355FF1幅旧肖像^000000，我就会以驯兽师的骄傲为你制作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
This is an item far beyond the pride of humans!
Its name?
^3355FFOrc Trophy^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
这件道具承载着人类难以企及的自豪。它的名字是？^3355FF兽人奖杯^000000！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Oh! You have all the items necessary to make an Orc Trophy! Good, good! With all my pride as a monster tamer, let me make one for you right away!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
哦！你带齐了制作兽人奖杯所需的材料！很好，很好！我会以驯兽师的骄傲，马上为你制作一个！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Got to...
Fit this Scorpion Tail...
Just right...
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
得...把这条蝎子尾巴装好...要恰到好处...

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Clang clang Boong*^000000

[Shogo]
Okay. All done.
Please take this for
the cute monster
you are raising...
Orc Trophy!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
好了，完成了。把这个送给你正在饲养的可爱魔物吧...兽人奖杯！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
For the monster owner
who is fond of Horror of Tribe...
One way to make Horror of Tribe !
^3355FF 1 Chivalry Emblem^000000!
^3355FF 1 Scorpion Tail^000000!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
喜欢兽人奖杯的魔物主人，可以用^3355FF1枚骑士团之证^000000和^3355FF1条蝎子尾巴^000000制作一份！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
If you bring these items to me,
with all my pride as a monster
tamer, I will make it for you!
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
把这些道具带给我，我就会以驯兽师的骄傲为你制作！

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Ah...!
You must have not decided which Monster you want to raise.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
啊...！
看来你还没有决定想饲养哪种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Shogo]
Definitely not a decision to be made carelessly! Your pet monster will accompany you throughout your life. Please take your time and return when you have decided.
scripts.translation:
[翔吾]
这绝对不是一个可以草率决定的事情！你的宠物魔物将陪伴你一生。请慢慢考虑，想好了再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
boy? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哎呀...年轻人，你见过我的孙女吗？我可怜的孙女失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's grandma]
Oh my...
Have you seen my granddaughter,
young lady? My poor granddaughter
has been missing...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哎呀...年轻女士，你见过我的孙女吗？我可怜的孙女失踪了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I can't remember exactly when it
was, but when I lived in Payon, I
had a cute granddaughter. She
was really happy when I made her
hair like ^000077Danggie^000000...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我不记得具体是哪一年了，但我住在斐扬时有个可爱的孙女。每次我给她梳成^000077丹吉^000000发型，她都高兴极了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
She was alwaying working with the
village chief... She was such a sweet
girl, and always got along with
chief's son...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
她总是和村长一起做事...她是个可爱的女孩，也总和村长的儿子相处得很好...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
But one day our deity became angry
and cursed the chief's son with a
sickness! The village had to offer
my granddaughter to him as a
companion to lift the curse...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
但有一天，神明发怒，让村长的儿子染上疾病！为了替他解除诅咒，村里只好把我的孙女送去陪伴他...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
The chief's son regained his
health, but I lost my
granddaughter! I can't look at him
and not think of her, so I tried to
leave my misery behind and came
here to Comodo...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
村长的儿子恢复了健康，我却失去了孙女！我一看到他就会想起她，于是离开了这份痛苦，来到了克魔岛...

scripts.text: Oh come on! Cheer up!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，别这样！振作起来！

scripts.text: Um, is this diary...?
scripts.translation: 嗯，这是日记...？

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems my granddaughter haunts my
dreams every night. I believe I've
been trying to cheer up for years
now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
看来孙女每晚都会出现在我的梦里。这些年来，我一直努力让自己振作起来...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh god!
It's my granddaughter's diary!
Th-This is her writing! Oh my...!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
天哪！这是我孙女的日记！这...这是她的笔迹！哎呀...！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young man... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
年轻人...请把日记和一件丹吉交给我，我就读给你听。我现在已经没有任何属于她的东西了...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Young lady... I'll read this to you if
you give it to me with a Danggie,
please. I no longer have anything
that belonged to her now...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
年轻女士...请把日记和一件丹吉交给我，我就读给你听。我现在已经没有任何属于她的东西了...

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行

scripts.text: Ok, I will.
scripts.translation: 好的，我会的

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Alright, young man.
Thank you anyway.
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦...？
好吧，年轻人。
还是谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh...?
Thank you anyway,
young lady
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦...？
还是要谢谢你，年轻女士。

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It's alright...
I can only hope that the deity is
taking good care of her!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
没关系...我只希望神明能好好照顾她！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh!
Thank you,
young man~!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦！谢谢你，年轻人~！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Goodness!
Thank you,
young lady...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
天哪！谢谢你，年轻女士...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Alright...
I'll read this.
Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
好吧...我来读读看。让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
It seems that my granddaughter was
treated by the chief like his own
child! There are so many happy
memories in this book!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
看来村长把我的孙女当作自己的孩子一样对待！日记里记录了许多快乐的回忆！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
Oh, thank you. I now have a good
keepsake of my granddaughter. Thank
you so much! May God-Poing bless
you!
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
哦，谢谢你。我现在有了孙女留下的美好纪念品。真的非常感谢你！愿波因之神保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
What? A diary? What's that diary...?
I don't... I can't remember, oh my...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
什么？日记？那本日记...？我...我不记得了，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
I really wish I could make her hair
into a ^000077Danggie^000000 again. I really
wish... Oh, oh my granddaughter...
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我真希望能再给她扎一次^000077丹吉^000000。我真希望...哦，我的孙女...

scripts.text:
[Munak's Grandma]
My own granddaughter...
Why did she have to leave...?
scripts.translation:
[僵尸女的奶奶]
我的孙女...她为什么要离开...？
